visualization.subtitle: Approximation from the sample size; not the trial's registered power calculation

notes.message: Power is approximated from the sample size with a two-sample z-test (alpha 0.05, two-sided); the registry does not report the trial's own power calculation.

power_inputs.n_source: actual participants started per arm (participant flow)

approximation.method: two-sample z-test normal approximation, power(d) = Phi(d*sqrt(n/2) - z_{0.975})
assumptions: Two-sided alpha = 0.05, two-sample z-test (normal approximation; opposite tail ignored).
Continuous endpoint with equal variance; effect size is standardized (Cohen's d).
Equal allocation: n per arm (unequal arms use the harmonic mean of the arm sizes).
No dropout, multiplicity, interim-analysis or non-inferiority adjustments.
This is not the trial's registered power calculation (the registry does not report one).
n per arm = 872.4 from actual participants started per arm (participant flow).
